oracle.method: 32/64-node tensor Beta quadrature plus analytic outcome-table first and second moments
oracle.limitations: Fixed-table posterior functional moments only; finite quadrature agreement is a numerical convergence check, not a formal error certificate. Does not establish posterior interval coverage or sampling calibration.

reference_review.scope: Conditional posterior functional mean and standard deviation for the retained confounded binary model; additional intervention and fixed-Z moments are reference context until separately asserted.
reference_review.independence_basis: Repository-authored integration over five independent Beta coordinates. Public roots_jacobi supplies tensor nodes; outcome coordinates are integrated analytically. The harness imports no product sampler, graph inference, estimator or test helper. reference_compare only compares shapes and values. 32/64-node agreement is checked at absolute 1e-12.
reference_review.historical_exposure: New reference authored from the declared conjugate model, public versioned SciPy documentation and the existing product assertion/count inputs. Earlier author exposure cannot be established; the historical product CountFittedModel comparison is retained and labelled internal.
reference_review.redistribution: Repository-authored harness/input fixture under MIT OR Apache-2.0; NumPy and SciPy BSD-3-Clause dependencies stay in the isolated pinned environment. No upstream implementation/test source is redistributed.
reference_review.limitations: One fixed conditioning scenario at 8000 draws, seed 17. Mean within five reference Monte Carlo standard errors and standard deviation within 5 percent. This is ordinary posterior-functional conformance, not repeated-sampling calibration or an interval license. Quadrature refinement agreement is not a rigorous general error bound.
